name: Speaker timer
description: A per-speaker countdown: turns amber near the end, red at zero, then counts the overtime as +m:ss.

params.name: speaker
params.help: Who is speaking now. Changing it restarts the timer

params.name: duration
params.help: Speaking time (seconds or m:ss, e.g. 5:00). Changing it restarts the timer

params.name: warn_at
params.help: Turn amber when this many seconds are left
